turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail:
2.0 · AI says:

You can add items like treats and probiotics to your upcoming order, but only before your order deadline. To do it:

Log into your account
Go to the Extras page
Click “Add to Order” and choose quantity and frequency

Once the deadline passes, changes (including adding items) can’t be made for that shipment.
